characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
characterization_methods.key_findings: A10 toughness 0.69 kJ/mol (95.8 J/cm³); elongation ≈15%; tensile strength lower than A15.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; 1 mm/min crosshead velocity; ASTM E8 RD specimens (gauge 12.5 × 3 × 2 mm)
characterization_methods.purpose: measure engineering stress–strain response and absorbed energy (toughness)

characterization_methods.key_findings: A10 fracture surface shows 'B2 stringer' and 'micro-crack' features (50 µm scale bar).
characterization_methods.purpose: fracture surface analysis at deformed tensile gauge

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Leica DM2700 M (optical); FESEM Apreo S
characterization_methods.key_findings: annealed samples retain B2 stringer bands, intragranular IG-B2 and intergranular GB-B2; URE-γ pancake structure persists.

defect_interactions.interaction_type: B2 stringer band de-cohesion / micro-crack nucleation
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Macrovoids nucleate inside B2 stringer bands; thicker bands crack at regular intervals; stringer band segment decohesion and microcrack merger lead to premature (biaxial) failure.

interfaces.phase_evolution: δ-ferrite transformed into lamellar B2 stringer bands by hot/cold rolling; annealing adds intragranular IG-B2 and intergranular GB-B2 precipitation.

phase_interfaces.coherence: high coherency strain (BCC B2 in FCC γ)

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ingot remelted 5–6 times without breaking vacuum in AM500-Edmund Buhler GmbH arc melter to improve elemental intermixing.
Sample A10 corresponds to the 10 min annealed condition of the standard-route CR sheet (samples A5/A10/A15/A30 denoted by annealing time).

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8, rolling direction (RD), gauge length 12.5 mm, gauge width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: A10 engineering stress–strain curve shown in Figure 5a (dark red); lower in stress than A15 and higher than A30, extending to ~15% strain.

grain_structure.texture: URE-γ pancake structure; RE-γ grain size increases with annealing time

phases_present.morphology: matrix; URE-γ coarse elongated pancake grains and RE-γ grains
phases_present.texture: URE-γ pancake structure elongated along prior rolling direction

precipitates.coherency: high coherency strain / activation-energy barrier (BCC B2 in FCC γ)
precipitates.distribution: needle-shaped; nucleated mainly inside URE-γ at shear bands
coarse, irregular; nucleated along prior austenite grain boundaries

microstructure_list.region: bands aligned along prior rolling direction

structures.overall_structure: Annealed (900 °C, 10 min, water quench) standard-route CR sheet: austenitic γ matrix with B2 stringer bands (≈16%) aligned along prior rolling direction, plus intragranular needle-like IG-B2 and coarse intergranular GB-B2 precipitates; unrecrystallized γ (URE-γ) retains pancake structure, and recrystallized γ (RE-γ) grains are present.

unmapped_findings: A10（标准路线，900 °C/10 min）未出现在图 3 的 3×3 FESEM 显微照片阵列中（该阵列仅展示 A5/A15/A30），因此论文未单独报道 A10 的 IG-B2/GB-B2 具体尺寸与体积分数数值（参见 b0021、b0022）。
